title: Adaptive Detoxification: Safeguarding General Capabilities of LLMs through Toxicity-Aware Knowledge Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's defense success (DS) rate against malicious queries and jailbreak attacks using the SafeEdit benchmark, which contains nine categories of unsafe content (including derogatory messaging about race, pornography, and illegal activities). The methodology uses a pre-trained RoBERTa-large safety classifier to automatically detect whether the generated responses are safe or toxic.
